+---
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: Collect sessions and nested sub-agent child sessions into the observable model
+---
+## What
+The agent will announce each sub-agent as an ACP child session (ACP v2 Subagent Sessions RFD: `subagent_update`, child `sessionId` on every update and request, `state_update` per child, `session_message`). The client must collect the root sessions AND the nested child sessions into one observable model.
+
+Today `ConnectionModel` (`Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/ConnectionModel.swift`) has `sessions: [SessionInfo]` from `session/list` and `openSessions: [SessionModel]`, and routes updates by session id (`SessionModel+Stream.swift`). It has no parent link and no child session.
+
+Change:
+- `SessionModel` gets `parent: SessionModel?` (weak), `children: [SessionModel]` (ordered by announce), `title`, `description`, `cwd`, `additionalDirectories`, and `workState` (running, requires_action, unknown, idle with `stopReason`/`error`). All are `@Observable` so a view tree can show root, child, grandchild.
+- `ConnectionModel` creates a child `SessionModel` on `subagent_update`, before any event of that id. It applies patch rules: omitted = unchanged, `null` clears, a value replaces; `capabilities` replace as a whole.
+- A child is NOT in `sessions` from `session/list`. It is reached through its parent only.
+- Updates and agent-to-client requests with a child id (permission, elicitation, file, terminal) go to the child model, not to the root. A pending request stays attributed to the child.
+- The client allows only what the child `capabilities` advertise. Today only `cancel`: `SessionModel.cancel()` on a child sends `session/cancel` with the child id. Prompt, close, delete, fork, load, resume, set mode and set config option on a child are refused locally. Slash commands of a child are not offered.
+- A child never ends. It goes `idle`. When the parent is closed, the children are removed. On `session/resume` with `replayFrom: start`, drop cached child state and capabilities before the replay and rebuild from it.
+- `session_message` and `session_message_chunk` go to the transcript of the outer `sessionId`; link sender and recipient views only by `senderMessageId`/`recipientMessageId`.
+- An update for an unknown child id with no announcement: keep it unexposed (do not guess a parent).
+
+Needs: the wire types (`subagentUpdate`, `sessionMessage`, child `capabilities`) in FoundationModelsACP. That change is not done yet and is being discussed; this task depends on it. Also see the plan on the FoundationModelsACPAgent board (tag `subagents`).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A `subagent_update` creates a child `SessionModel` with `parent` set and the parent `children` updated; a nested one gives a three level tree.
+- [ ] Events with the child id reach only the child model.
+- [ ] `session/list` refresh never adds a child to `ConnectionModel.sessions`.
+- [ ] `cancel()` on a child sends `session/cancel` with the child id; `prompt()` on a child throws without sending.
+- [ ] `workState` follows `state_update`; `idle` with `stopReason: cancelled` after a cancel.
+- [ ] Resume with replay rebuilds the tree, parent before child, and drops old child capabilities.
+- [ ] An update with an unannounced child id changes no model.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPClientTests/SubagentSessionModelTests.swift`: tree build, patch rules, routing, restriction, cancel, replay, unannounced id. Use the in-process agent (`InProcessAgent.swift`) or a scripted connection.
+- [ ] Observation test: a change of `workState` or `children` fires the `@Observable` tracking.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter SubagentSessionModelTests`. All pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #subagents
\ No newline at end of file
